notes: Official Study in NL fees page: statutory fee, non-EEA ranges, handling fee. Deterministic scraper, no LLM.
DAAD International Programmes database (official DAAD portal). Solr JSON API through a browser session; degree programmes only (courseType 1/2). Deterministic, no LLM.
Bulk programme discovery via the finder's public JSON API (api/programs). Deterministic, no LLM, no browser needed: the API returns structured records.

Opintopolku / Studyinfo search API with kieli=en filter (Finnish National Agency for Education). Deterministic, no LLM. Fees not in the search payload; a per-implementation detail harvest can add them later.
University Admissions in Sweden (UHR) course search API (POST /intl/api/sok). Master + bachelor sweeps, English-instruction filter applied client-side. Deterministic, no LLM.
Study in Estonia (Education and Youth Board) server-rendered programme tables for bachelor/master/doctoral. Plain fetch + table parsing, no LLM, no browser.
Study in Norway (Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills) Drupal listing + per-programme detail pages. Plain fetches, no LLM, no browser.
Study in Denmark programme portal (Volto/Plone). Plone querystring-search API through a browser session (WAF + cookie wall). English-taught degrees only. Deterministic, no LLM.
TaughtIE / Campus France catalogue API (tie-api.campusfrance.org). List + per-programme detail fetches. English-taught only (levels 12/26); fee text kept verbatim in notes. Deterministic, no LLM.
